summary: Watched 6 Geography Shorts of 22-27 Nov (plus Lesotho's new drops); extended lesson 1 with its first repeat and added new numbers to the ending test. No new lesson.
why: Australia's fence (made after lesson 1) opened its second beat on bare sand: 13.9% left at 5.7 s before the cliffs and wire appeared, and it has the channel's lowest stayed to watch (48.8% vs a 58.3% median). Nothing else reached a 15% drop at a beat or 10 points under the median, except the comment question at the end (Antarctica 20.0%), which stays a test.

findings.title: Lesson 1 repeated once
findings.detail: v-20261125-11: second beat opens at 4.3 s on bare sand and a dashed line; cliffs at 5.5 s, wire at 6.7 s; 13.9% left at 5.7 s. Stayed 48.8%.

findings.title: Ending question cost 20% on Antarctica
findings.detail: 61.1 s, 43% to 23% on 'which new coastline surprised you more? Tell me below'; Australia 14.1%. Added to challenger geo-loop-no-question.

findings.title: Best two keep a labelled thing in every frame
findings.detail: Malacca 61.9% (end hold 0.56) and Russia 60.7% lost 13.5% at the second beat and only 5-7% at the end.

changes.title: Lesson 1 extended
changes.detail: Seen in: Australia's fence (repeat), Panama, Lesotho; Fix: the thing is in frame on the beat's first word, and the next line doesn't stack figures.

changes.title: Challenger geo-loop-no-question: new evidence
changes.detail: Antarctica -20.0%, Australia -14.1% on the comment question.
